construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
State Annual Progress Report 2018 row for APN 25940088, 171 Post St, project name HA14-023-02: 28 above-moderate rental units entitled 2018-06-06.

Bisnow (2015-05-27) reports Simeon Residential Properties' parcel at Post and San Pedro streets, across from the downtown Greyhound station, approved for 182 residences and about 7,000 sq ft of retail in a 21-story apartment building, with Kinship Capital as equity partner and groundbreaking targeted for early 2016.

Farella Braun + Martel, reprinting The Registry (2015-06-08), reports a Kinship Capital and SIMEON Commercial Properties joint venture purchase of the Post Street Tower project in downtown San Jose, planned for 182 apartments, 7,000 sq ft of retail and a 230-stall parking facility.
County parcel data lists the situs of APN 259-40-088 as S San Pedro St, San Jose 95113.
